title: The evolution of territorial agrifood systems between global and local dynamics: Insights from hazelnut production in Tuscia (Italy)
title_zh: 地域农业食品系统在全球与地方动态之间的演变：来自意大利图西亚榛子生产的洞见
title_primary: 地域农业食品系统在全球与地方动态之间的演变：来自意大利图西亚榛子生产的洞见
title_secondary: The evolution of territorial agrifood systems between global and local dynamics: Insights from hazelnut production in Tuscia (Italy)
authors: Adanella Rossi, Michela Lazzeroni, Paola Zamperlin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Globalisation and industrialisation have over time generated profound changes in the agrifood system, producing multiple effects with strong spatial characteristics. These include de-territorialisation, accompanied by standardisation, specialisation and intensification. These processes have often determined significant impacts on rural territories and communities, due to the primacy of specific economic interests over the priorities of local socio-ecological systems. As a reaction to these dynamics, new paths have emerged, oriented to food re-localisation and sustainability transition and, more generally, seeking a more democratic approach in governing food systems and local development. Transitions of territorial agrifood systems indeed become the outcome of complex interaction dynamics established among different, multi-scale networks, reflecting their respective visions, objectives and power. Against such a background, this paper aims to contribute to the understanding of the transformations of specific territorial agrifood systems, marked by tensions between global forces and local dynamics. To that end it applies an analytical framework interrelating actors’ role and interactions, discursive components, and policies and governance issues. Focusing on the rural area of Tuscia (Italy), it analyses the expansion of the problematic hazelnut production. Tracing the long-term evolution of the territorial agrifood system and of governance dynamics, it reflects on the critical issues associated with the presence of global-scale economic activities in specific territorial contexts, and on the challenges faced by sustainable, locally tailored and community-driven development trajectories. The analysis helps deepen understanding of these processes and provides significant insights for the scientific debate, policy-makers and social groups involved in this type of process.
abstract_zh: 全球化与工业化长期以来推动了农业食品系统的深刻变革，产生了具有强烈空间特征的多重效应。这些效应包括去地域化，并伴随标准化、专业化和集约化。由于特定经济利益优先于地方社会-生态系统的发展重点，这些过程往往对乡村地域和社区造成显著影响。作为对这些动态的回应，新的路径已经出现，其导向是食品再地方化和可持续性转型，更广泛地说，是寻求在治理食品系统和地方发展中采取更加民主的方式。地域农业食品系统的转型实际上成为不同多尺度网络之间复杂互动动态的结果，反映了各自不同的愿景、目标和权力。在此背景下，本文旨在增进对特定地域农业食品系统转型的理解，这些系统以全球力量与地方动态之间的张力为特征。为此，本文应用了一个将行动者角色与互动、话语成分以及政策与治理问题相互关联的分析框架。本文聚焦意大利图西亚（Tuscia）乡村地区，分析了存在问题的榛子生产的扩张。通过追溯地域农业食品系统和治理动态的长期演变，本文反思了与全球尺度经济活动存在于特定地域情境中相关的关键问题，以及可持续的、因地制宜且由社区驱动的发展轨迹所面临的挑战。该分析有助于加深对这些过程的理解，并为科学讨论、政策制定者以及参与此类过程的社会群体提供了重要洞见。

title: Policy Transition Risk, Carbon Premiums, and Asset Prices
title_zh: 政策转型风险、碳溢价与资产价格
title_primary: 政策转型风险、碳溢价与资产价格
title_secondary: Policy Transition Risk, Carbon Premiums, and Asset Prices
authors: Christoph Hambel, Frederick van der Ploeg
official: 官方在线 2025-03-06 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We analyze the effects of policy transition risk on asset pricing and the green transition using a global two-sector, macro-finance model of climate and the economy. Policy transition risk results from probabilistic changes between three policy states: no, modest, and ambitious carbon pricing. We show that policy transition risk leads to carbon premiums (i.e. higher expected returns on brown than on green assets), especially if the economy is still quite carbon-intensive and close to the temperature cap, and thus accelerate the green transition. Increased transition risk leads to more precautionary saving and falls in the risk-free rate. We offer extensions to deal with physical risks (temperature-related risk of climate disasters and climate tipping), technology transition risk, and more realistic policy tipping with endogenous transition probabilities. • Policy transition risk leads to carbon premiums and a faster green transition. • Risks of climate-related disasters and climate tipping push up the carbon price. • Climate policy shocks have a significant impact on asset prices and returns. • Price impacts are more pronounced if carbon-intensive capital is more prevalent.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个全球两部门、宏观金融的气候与经济模型，分析了政策转型风险对资产定价和绿色转型的影响。政策转型风险源于三种政策状态之间的概率性变化：无碳定价、适度碳定价和雄心勃勃的碳定价。研究表明，政策转型风险会导致碳溢价（即棕色资产预期回报高于绿色资产），尤其是在经济仍高度碳密集且接近温度上限时，从而加速绿色转型。转型风险的增加会引发更多预防性储蓄，并导致无风险利率下降。我们提供了扩展分析，以处理物理风险（与温度相关的气候灾害风险和气候临界点风险）、技术转型风险，以及具有内生转型概率的更现实的政策临界点情形。• 政策转型风险导致碳溢价并加速绿色转型。• 气候相关灾害和气候临界点风险推高碳价格。• 气候政策冲击对资产价格和回报有显著影响。• 当碳密集型资本更为普遍时，价格影响更为显著。

title: Of hired guns and ideologues: Why would a law firm ever retain an honest expert witness?
title_zh: 雇佣枪手与意识形态者：律师事务所为何会聘请诚实的专家证人？
title_primary: 雇佣枪手与意识形态者：律师事务所为何会聘请诚实的专家证人？
title_secondary: Of hired guns and ideologues: Why would a law firm ever retain an honest expert witness?
authors: Martin Richardson, Jose Rodrigues‐Neto
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Suppose that expert witnesses appearing in litigation are, generically, either honest in their assessment of a fact situation or are advocates who testify in favour of their retaining party, regardless of new information. The type of a witness is known to law firms, who engage with them repeatedly, but not to courts. If the only way an honest witness can credibly reveal their type to a court is by agreeing with some of the position of the opposing party, then the question arises of why a law firm would ever retain an honest expert. We show that it can act as a signalling device in a game between the law firms to communicate private information regarding a party's confidence in winning the case. Our results indicate, inter alia, that the “English” rule of costs allocation can make a socially desirable separating equilibrium less likely, compared to the “American” rule.
abstract_zh: 假设在诉讼中出庭的专家证人，大体上可分为两类：一类对其所面对的事实情况评估诚实，另一类则是不论新信息如何，都倾向于为其委托方作证的辩护型证人。律师事务所因与证人反复打交道而知晓其类型，但法院对此并不知情。如果诚实证人能向法院可信地揭示其类型的唯一途径，是部分认同对方当事人的立场，那么问题便产生了：律师事务所为何会聘请诚实专家？我们证明，在律师事务所之间传递关于其案件胜诉信心的私人信息博弈中，这可以作为一种信号机制。我们的研究结果尤其表明，与“美国”规则相比，“英国”的费用分配规则可能使社会期望的分离均衡更难以实现。

title: Compound exposure of cropland to extreme precipitation and transportation disadvantage in China
title_zh: 中国农田极端降水与交通不便的复合暴露研究
title_primary: 中国农田极端降水与交通不便的复合暴露研究
title_secondary: Compound exposure of cropland to extreme precipitation and transportation disadvantage in China
authors: Yuxin Pan, Hongyu Lyu, Haoyu Hu, Zuge Xing, Liangen Zeng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Global climate change and extreme precipitation events pose increasing threats to agricultural systems worldwide. However, existing studies often fail to integrate the synergistic effects of precipitation, neglect the role of transportation infrastructure, and rely on data with coarse spatial resolution. To address these gaps, this study develops a “climate–cropland–transportation” framework. By integrating high-resolution hourly precipitation data (0.1˚) and 30 m cropland distribution data, we quantified the thresholds, frequency, and intensity of extreme precipitation to construct a Cropland Extreme Precipitation Exposure ( CEPE ) index using the entropy weighting method. Four transportation accessibility scenarios—considering the presence or absence of expressways connecting prefecture- and county-level cities—were simulated to examine their spatial coupling with the CEPE . The results reveal pronounced spatial heterogeneity in CEPE across the study area. Rural population density and industrial structure exert nonlinear regulatory effects on cropland exposure to extreme precipitation. Extreme precipitation intensity peaks at moderate population levels, while areas where the primary industry accounts for 30–40% of the economy constitute a critical buffering zone. Geographically, croplands in southwest China remain highly threatened by extreme precipitation, whereas the exposure fluctuates considerably across the Huang–Huai–Hai Plain and the Northeast China Plain. Uneven transportation accessibility further amplifies these exposures, creating vulnerability traps in regions with high exposure but low accessibility, such as the Northeast China Plain. These findings offer valuable insights for developing targeted agricultural and infrastructure strategies to strengthen agricultural resilience under climate extremes.
abstract_zh: 全球气候变化与极端降水事件对全球农业系统构成日益严重的威胁。然而，现有研究往往未能整合降水的协同效应，忽视了交通基础设施的作用，且依赖空间分辨率较粗的数据。为弥补上述不足，本研究构建了“气候—农田—交通”分析框架。通过整合高分辨率逐时降水数据（0.1˚）与30米农田分布数据，量化了极端降水的阈值、频率和强度，并采用熵权法构建了农田极端降水暴露度（CEPE）指数。本研究模拟了四种交通可达性情景——考虑地级市与县级市之间高速公路的有无——以考察其与CEPE的空间耦合关系。结果表明，研究区域内CEPE呈现显著的空间异质性。农村人口密度与产业结构对农田极端降水暴露度产生非线性调节效应。极端降水强度在中等人口水平下达到峰值，而第一产业占经济比重30%—40%的地区构成关键缓冲地带。从地理分布看，中国西南地区农田仍面临极端降水的高度威胁，而黄淮海平原和东北平原的暴露度则波动较大。交通可达性的不均衡进一步加剧了上述暴露风险，在高暴露但低可达性的地区（如东北平原）形成了脆弱性陷阱。上述发现为制定针对性的农业与基础设施策略、增强气候极端事件下的农业韧性提供了有价值的参考。

title: Lifting up the Lives of Extremely Disadvantaged Youth: The Role of Staying in School Longer
title_zh: 提升极度弱势青年的生活境遇：延长在校时间的作用
title_primary: 提升极度弱势青年的生活境遇：延长在校时间的作用
title_secondary: Lifting up the Lives of Extremely Disadvantaged Youth: The Role of Staying in School Longer
authors: Julie Moschion, Jan C. van Ours
official: 官方在线 2025-02-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using a sample of Australians who display high rates of early school-leaving, we compare the trajectories of respondents who left school at each incremental age between 14 and 17 with respondents who left at 18 years old or more, in terms of homelessness, incarceration, substance use and mental health issues. Leveraging recent methodological advances, we estimate a staggered difference-in-difference to: eliminate biases arising from reverse causality or unobserved time-invariant unobserved heterogeneity and account for heterogenous treatment effects across cohorts and time. Results indicate that leaving school before age 18 increases males’ likelihood of experiencing homeless, being incarcerated, using cannabis daily and illegal street drugs weekly several years after school-leaving. In contrast, for females the difference-in-difference strategy eliminates the correlations between school-leaving age and their outcomes, providing some support for a causal interpretation of our findings. To minimise concerns that gender specific time-varying unobserved heterogeneity may be driving our results, we also show that while the occurrence and timing of parental separation and other adverse behaviours coincide with early school-leaving, our results are robust to accounting for these. Taken together, our findings suggest that preventing early school-leaving can help disadvantaged youth break cycles of multi-dimensional disadvantage.
abstract_zh: 利用一组早期辍学率较高的澳大利亚样本，我们比较了在14至17岁之间各年龄辍学的受访者与18岁及以上辍学的受访者在无家可归、监禁、物质使用和心理健康问题方面的轨迹。借助近期方法论上的进展，我们采用交错双重差分法，以消除由反向因果或未观测到的时不变异质性引起的偏差，并考虑不同队列和时间上的处理效应异质性。结果显示，18岁前辍学增加了男性在辍学数年后经历无家可归、被监禁、每日使用大麻及每周使用非法街头药物的可能性。相比之下，对于女性，双重差分策略消除了辍学年龄与其结果之间的相关性，这在一定程度上支持了我们发现的因果解释。为尽量减少性别特定的时变异质性可能驱动结果的担忧，我们还表明，尽管父母分居及其他不良行为的发生和时机与早期辍学相吻合，但我们的结果在考虑这些因素后依然稳健。综合来看，我们的发现表明，防止早期辍学有助于弱势青年打破多维劣势的循环。

title: Temporary exclusion in repeated contests
title_zh: 重复竞赛中的临时排除
title_primary: 重复竞赛中的临时排除
title_secondary: Temporary exclusion in repeated contests
authors: Yaron Azrieli
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Consider a population of agents who repeatedly compete for awards, as in the case of researchers annually applying for grants. Noise in the selection process may encourage entry of low-quality proposals, forcing the principal to commit large resources to reviewing applications and further increasing award misallocation. A temporary exclusion policy prohibits an agent from applying in the current period if they received a low evaluation in the previous. We study the steady-state equilibria under various policies of this type. With exclusion, agents that have low-quality applications self-select to stay out, which reduces the volume of submissions and mitigates award misallocation. At the same time, the volume of high-quality applications is also reduced due to the ineligibility of banned agents. We also show that exclusion has a distributional effect, where higher-ability agents exhibit more self-selection.
abstract_zh: 考虑一群代理人反复竞争奖项的情形，例如研究人员每年申请资助的情况。评选过程中的噪音可能鼓励低质量提案的进入，迫使委托方投入大量资源审查申请，并进一步加剧奖项分配不当。一项临时排除政策规定，若代理人在上一期获得低评价，则禁止其在本期申请。我们研究了此类政策下各种情形的稳态均衡。在排除政策下，拥有低质量申请的代理人会选择自行退出，从而减少提交量并缓解奖项分配不当。同时，由于被禁止代理人的资格受限，高质量申请的数量也会减少。我们还表明，排除政策具有分配效应，其中能力较高的代理人表现出更多的自我选择行为。

title: Falling Fertility: The Changing Value of Freedom, Fulfillment, and Family
title_zh: 生育率下降：自由、自我实现与家庭价值的变迁
title_primary: 生育率下降：自由、自我实现与家庭价值的变迁
title_secondary: Falling Fertility: The Changing Value of Freedom, Fulfillment, and Family
authors: Raquel Fernández, Inés Berniell, Milagros Onofri
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Fertility has fallen in nearly all high-income countries. People also report wanting fewer children: between 2012 and 2022 the ideal number of children fell from 2.42 to 2.31 and the share of respondents intending a child within three years fell from 28 to 21 percent over a similar period. Why? Using two cross-national surveys that ask respondents about their attitudes and their fertility preferences, both fielded twice roughly a decade apart, we decompose each decline into the contribution of a broad and competing set of attitudes. Three stand out: children are increasingly seen as interfering with the freedom of parents; views on whether mothers of young children should work have become markedly more progressive and account for a substantially larger share of the decline among the tertiary-educated; and fewer people believe that women or men need children to lead a fulfilled life. This last attitude changed most over the decade and is the largest contributor to the fall in intended fertility, above all among less-educated women. The changing division of household work and increasing work-family conflict have minor contributions to changing fertility preferences.
abstract_zh: 几乎所有高收入国家的生育率均有所下降。人们也报告称希望生育更少的孩子：在2012年至2022年间，理想子女数从2.42降至2.31，而在相近时期内，表示三年内有意生育孩子的受访者比例从28%降至21%。原因何在？利用两项跨国调查，这些调查询问受访者的态度及生育偏好，且每项调查均相隔约十年进行两次，我们将每次下降分解为一系列广泛且相互竞争的态度所贡献的部分。其中三项态度尤为突出：孩子日益被视为妨碍父母自由的因素；对于年幼孩子的母亲是否应工作的看法已显著变得更加进步，并在高等教育程度群体中占据了下降份额的更大比例；以及越来越少的人认为女性或男性需要孩子才能过上充实的生活。最后一种态度在十年间变化最大，并且是导致预期生育率下降的最大贡献因素，尤其是在教育程度较低的女性中。家务分工的变化及工作与家庭冲突的加剧对生育偏好变化的影响较小。

title: Short-Term Pain for Long-Term Gain: Market Deregulation and Monetary Policy in Small Open Economies
title_zh: 短期阵痛与长期收益：小开放经济体中的市场放松管制与货币政策
title_primary: 短期阵痛与长期收益：小开放经济体中的市场放松管制与货币政策
title_secondary: Short-Term Pain for Long-Term Gain: Market Deregulation and Monetary Policy in Small Open Economies
authors: Matteo Cacciatore, Romain Duval, Giuseppe Fiori, Fabio Ghironi
official: 官方在线 2015-12-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper explores the effects of labor and product market reforms in a New Keynesian, small open economy model with labor market frictions and endogenous producer entry. We show that it takes time for reforms to pay off, typically at least a couple of years. This is partly because the benefits materialize through firm entry and increased hiring, both of which are gradual processes, while any reform-driven layoffs are immediate. Some reforms---such as reductions in employment protection---increase unemployment temporarily. Implementing a broad package of labor and product market reforms minimizes transition costs. Importantly, reforms do not have noticeable deflationary effects, suggesting that the inability of monetary policy to deliver large interest rate cuts in their aftermath---either because of the zero bound on policy rates or because of membership in a monetary union---may not be a relevant obstacle to reform. Alternative simple monetary policy rules do not have a large effect on transition costs.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在新凯恩斯小型开放经济模型中，劳动力与产品市场改革的影响，该模型包含劳动力市场摩擦与内生性企业进入。我们表明，改革产生成效需要时间，通常至少数年。部分原因在于，改革收益通过企业进入和招聘增加得以实现，而这两者均为渐进过程，而改革引发的裁员则是即时的。某些改革——如降低就业保护——会暂时性推高失业率。实施涵盖劳动力与产品市场的广泛改革方案，能最小化转型成本。重要的是，改革并未产生显著的通缩效应，这表明货币政策在改革后无法大幅降息——无论是因政策利率触及零下限，还是因成员国身份限制——可能并非改革面临的实质性障碍。替代性的简单货币政策规则对转型成本的影响不大。

abstract: In the cardinal part of their analysis of spherical preferences, Chambers and Echenique (2020) characterise quadratic-plus-linear utility using two axioms concerning changes from a status quo: Status Quo Independence (SQI) and Eventual Linearity (EL). We show that the two axioms are not independent. Specifically, SQI implies EL and, indeed, forces the additivity condition in EL to hold at every status quo, not merely at some status quo. Consequently, under continuity and normalisation, SQI alone characterises the representation, implying that their cardinal theorem remains valid when EL is dropped. The respective roles of continuity and normalisation are also clarified.

abstract: Occupational licensing has attracted growing attention in advanced economies, yet little has been known about its prevalence outside the US. This column presents new evidence from 44 countries using nationally representative surveys. It shows that licensing is widespread around the world and, surprisingly, is often more common in developing economies than in richer nations. Higher occupational licensing is associated with lower per capita incomes and higher informal employment rates. These patterns suggest occupational licensing deserves greater attention as part of the broader debate over labour market regulation, informality, and economic development.

abstract: We study the aftermath of the 1968 Washington, D.C. civil disturbance to illuminate the mechanisms that drive urban redevelopment in the presence of low demand and racial tension. abstract: This study examines how fluctuations in firm-level uncertainty arise over the business cycle and how they influence aggregate economic activity. To do so, it develops a general equilibrium incomplete-markets model in which heterogeneous, risk-averse firms face idiosyncratic demand uncertainty and aggregate shocks to consumer credit conditions. A change in aggregate credit affects not only the expected level of firm demand, but also the cross-sectional dispersion of sales per worker by shifting the probability that firms operate at capacity. Thus, first-moment shocks give rise to endogenous second-moment effects. The model is disciplined using U.S. Compustat data on firm sales and employment and proprietary customer traffic data. The calibrated economy reproduces key cross-sectional moments and business-cycle comovements, including counter cyclical dispersion in firm outcomes. Quantitatively, endogenous uncertainty accounts for roughly one quarter of the output response and one third of the employment response to aggregate credit shocks. The results suggest that uncertainty is not only an independent source of aggregate fluctuations, but also an endogenous propagation mechanism through which changes in demand conditions amplify business cycles.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨企业层面不确定性如何随经济周期波动，以及这种波动如何影响总体经济活动。为此，构建了一个一般均衡不完全市场模型，其中异质性风险厌恶企业面临异质性需求不确定性和消费者信贷条件的总体冲击。总体信贷变化不仅影响企业需求的预期水平，还通过改变企业产能利用率概率，导致人均销售额的横截面离散度发生变化。因此，一阶矩冲击会引发内生性二阶矩效应。该模型采用美国Compustat数据库的企业销售与就业数据以及专有客流量数据进行校准。校准后的经济模型再现了关键横截面矩特征与经济周期联动性，包括企业绩效的反周期离散度。定量分析表明，内生不确定性解释了总体信贷冲击对产出响应的约四分之一，以及对就业响应的约三分之一。研究结果表明，不确定性不仅是总体经济波动的独立来源，更是需求条件变化放大经济周期的内生传导机制。

abstract: We document the effects of a comprehensive set of mergers of US consumer packaged goods manufacturers on prices, quantities, and product assortment. Across specifications, we find a small average price effect of mergers (-0.5% to 1.1%) but substantial heterogeneity in effects, with a standard deviation between 3.9–7.6 pp. Through a model of enforcement, we find that agencies act as if they challenge mergers they expect would increase prices more than 4.8–6.3%. abstract: Emerging datasets capture rich temporal variation in recreation behavior, but recreation demand analyses have traditionally used variation across sites, rather than across time, to value environmental amenities. We introduce a model and estimation procedure designed to exploit panel variation in recreation demand analyses by embedding panel data causal inference techniques within a travel cost random utility model. To demonstrate the method, we use “structural synthetic controls” to value the welfare losses caused by water-quality-induced beach closures in southeast Michigan. Losses tend to be larger on weekends and hotter days, and our results suggest that a stigma effect reduces visitation even after the beach reopens. Our method is particularly useful for valuing the recreational impacts of resource shocks, like harmful algal blooms or wildfires, and it can be applied broadly given the increasing availability of high-frequency recreation data.

abstract: This study provides city-level causal evidence on the economic effects of data trading infrastructure. Treating the staggered establishment of data trading platforms (DTPs) across Chinese cities between 2014 and 2023 as a quasi-natural experiment, we estimate a multi-period difference-in-differences model using a balanced panel of 298 prefecture-level cities from 2000 to 2023. The baseline estimate indicates that DTP establishment increases night-time light intensity – our primary proxy for urban economic vitality – by 3.610 units, robust across all sensitivity specifications. Event-study analysis validates parallel trends, and a randomization-inference placebo test yields an empirical p-value below 0.001. A Bartik instrumental variable strategy produces a 2SLS estimate of 9.421 (p < 0.05), which we interpret as complementary given a moderately relevant first stage (F = 2.71). Mechanism tests reveal that DTPs promote innovation and digital economy employment. A dose–response analysis shows that each additional year of platform operation increases vitality by 0.876 units on average, but the marginal effect turns negative in cities with below-median internet penetration. These findings establish that DTPs can serve as effective institutional vehicles for data factor marketization, but their economic returns are contingent on complementary digital infrastructure investments.

abstract: Online auctions have declined in popularity, often due to their high transaction costs. This paper focuses on one such cost: the hassle cost of bidding in often prolonged online auctions. We develop a structural model of ascending auctions with costly bidding that resembles a war of attrition. We show that even in private value settings, bidders strategically lower their bids to avoid hassle. Using data from a large online auto auction platform, we estimate that the average winner incurs hassle costs equivalent to 1.7% of the vehicle’s sale price, while sellers lose 5.0% in revenue due to bid-shading. Counterfactual simulations suggest that higher reserve prices can limit unproductive bidding and partially offset the loss.
abstract_zh: 在线拍卖的受欢迎程度有所下降，这往往归因于其高昂的交易成本。本文聚焦于其中一种成本：在通常漫长的在线拍卖中出价所带来的麻烦成本。我们构建了一个带有昂贵出价的结构性升价拍卖模型，该模型类似于消耗战。我们证明，即使在私有价值情境下，竞标者也会策略性地降低出价以避免麻烦。利用一个大型在线汽车拍卖平台的数据，我们估计平均获胜者承担的麻烦成本相当于车辆售价的1.7%，而卖家因出价缩减损失了5.0%的收入。反事实模拟表明，更高的保留价可以限制非生产性出价，并部分抵消这一损失。

title: The Customer Is Always Right? How LLMs and Humans Judge Discrimination
title_zh: 学生时间的财政不承认：衡量美国公立K-12教育中的强制性学生学时

title_secondary: The Customer Is Always Right? How LLMs and Humans Judge Discrimination
authors: Bunel, Mathieu, Tovar, Elisabeth, Lefebvre, Marie-Noëlle, BUNEL, Mathieu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how large language models (LLMs) trade off moral norms against economic incentives in discriminatory hiring decisions. Bridging discrimination economics and the literature on the moral alignment in computer science, we submit 18 frontier and local LLMs to the factorial vignette experiment of a published human survey that manipulates the motive of discrimination (customer taste-based versus statistical), the cost of non-discrimination, and explicit moral injunctions. We extend this design with LLM-relevant factors: model and user personas, reasoning instructions, scenario realism, and conversational memory. In line with the literature, we find that LLMs align with humans in the direction of the effects manipulated in the survey; we also find important inter-model heterogeneity. Beyond, we contribute to the literature with, to the best of our knowledge, five novel results: 1) the market-oriented motive (customer-taste) overwhelmingly sways models in favour of discrimination, much more than what happens for human respondents; 2) models are more polarised than humans in response to moral injunctions; 3) classic prompt engineering interventions (user stated motives and model personas) have a weak impact on the models’ “moral compass”; 4) post-training alignement, not scale, shape inter-model heterogeneity, which means that de-biasing is possible but must be explicitly implemented by model providers and 5) memory effects suggest that moral permissivity in the models can be induced by conversational contextual effects.
abstract_zh: 数据中心目前占美国电力需求的4.4%，然而，超大规模企业用于宣称碳中和的可再生能源证书（RECs）和购电协议（PPAs）在电网层面的有效性仍不明确。我们构建了一个博弈论模型，其中数据中心运营商在RECs、PPAs和表后共置之间进行选择，而发电商则在内生融资成本下做出进入决策。该模型识别出一个时间错配——即电力消费与可归因的可再生能源发电之间的时间差——作为核心机制，通过这一机制，即使RECs覆盖100%的年度消费，AI需求仍会降低可靠性、推高电价并增加排放。配备储能的共置模式直接解决了这一时间错配，并通过消除发电商的收入风险，促使最大规模的可再生能源进入。我们利用大语言模型的分阶段发布作为自然实验，通过双重差分法对连接AI活动与地方电网结果的新数据集进行检验，以验证这些预测。AI需求显著增加了数据中心附近化石燃料发电量、批发价格（在受影响的PJM区域高达25%）和停电频率（每年额外增加0.5至1次停电），且影响规模随模型尺寸扩大。配备现场发电的数据中心在电能质量效应上表现出符号反转，这与模型预测一致。

title: The Practice of U.S. Monetary Policy Independence from Martin to Greenspan
title_zh: 从马丁到格林斯潘时期美国货币政策独立性的实践
title_primary: 从马丁到格林斯潘时期美国货币政策独立性的实践
title_secondary: The Practice of U.S. Monetary Policy Independence from Martin to Greenspan
authors: Edward Nelson
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Central bank independence is a major area of study, but the economic literature has been characterized by numerous misstatements regarding how U.S. monetary policy independence has operated over time. Against this backdrop, this paper lays out major elements of the practice of central bank independence in the United States in the period from 1951 to 2006—a time span that encompasses the William McChesney Martin, Jr., through Alan Greenspan tenures as the head of the Federal Reserve. Many documentary materials and policymaker quotations not considered in previous research on U.S. monetary policy are highlighted. The analysis covers both institutional aspects (statutory objectives, formalities of Federal Reserve structure, and conventions followed in regularizing the central bank’s interactions with the legislative and executive branches) and the conceptual basis for independence, as expressed by leading Federal Reserve officials, particularly Chairs. It is shown—with heavy reliance on their own words—how Federal Reserve Chairs have characterized the position of the central bank within the governmental structure of the United States and how they have set out the case for monetary policy independence. What emerges is that successive Chairs over the decades made essentially the same, three-part, economic case for independence. This case does not rely on the arguments associated with economic research on time inconsistency.
abstract_zh: 中央银行独立性是一个重要的研究领域，但关于美国货币政策独立性如何随时间运作的经济学文献中，存在诸多不准确表述。在此背景下，本文梳理了1951年至2006年间美国中央银行独立性的实践要素——这一时期涵盖小威廉·麦克切斯尼·马丁至艾伦·格林斯潘担任美联储主席的任期。本文重点引用了此前美国货币政策研究中未涉及的诸多文献资料与政策制定者言论。分析涵盖制度层面（法定目标、美联储组织架构形式、规范央行与立法及行政部门互动的惯例）以及美联储主要官员（尤其是主席）所阐述的独立性概念基础。通过大量引用其原话，本文展示了美联储主席如何界定央行在美国政府架构中的地位，以及如何论证货币政策独立性的必要性。研究表明，数十年来历任主席实质上提出了相同的、由三部分构成的经济独立性论证。这一论证并不依赖于与时间不一致性相关的经济学研究论点。

title: Nowcasting Low-Income Countries Through Global Linkages
title_zh: 通过全球联系对低收入国家进行即时预测
title_primary: 通过全球联系对低收入国家进行即时预测
title_secondary: Nowcasting Low-Income Countries Through Global Linkages
authors: Omer Faruk Akbal & Domenico Giannone
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Timely assessment of economic activity is crucial for effective policymaking at the national, regional, and global levels. However, many economies still do not publish GDP data at a quarterly basis, creating persistent information gaps. In 2025, 34% of economies publish only annual GDP statistics. This lack of higher-frequency and timely data is particularly restrictive for emerging market and developing economies, where economic volatility and spillover risks are often highest. The problem is more severe for historical data: only 42% of economies have quarterly GDP estimates for a period longer than 20 years. To address these gaps, this paper develops a model that estimates missing quarterly GDP series by leveraging global and regional economic interconnections. The method transforms sparse annual data into quarterly estimates by exploiting higher-frequency information from the rest of the world, enabling real-time policymaking in both data-scarce economies and in global-level discussions. Moreover, this method ensures internally consistent estimates of regional and global economic activity, allowing both top-down and bottom-up scenario analyses.
abstract_zh: 及时评估经济活动对于国家、区域及全球层面的有效政策制定至关重要。然而，许多经济体仍未按季度发布GDP数据，导致持续存在信息缺口。2025年，34%的经济体仅发布年度GDP统计数据。这种高频及时数据的缺失对新兴市场和发展中经济体尤为不利，这些地区的经济波动和溢出风险往往最高。历史数据问题更为严峻：仅有42%的经济体拥有超过20年的季度GDP估算数据。为弥补这些缺口，本文构建了一个模型，通过利用全球和区域经济相互关联性来估算缺失的季度GDP序列。该方法借助世界其他地区的高频信息，将稀疏的年度数据转化为季度估算值，从而支持数据稀缺经济体及全球层面的实时政策制定。此外，该方法能确保区域和全球经济活动估算的内部一致性，支持自上而下与自下而上的情景分析。

title: The digital shock absorber: can data assets influence supply chain resilience?
title_zh: 数字减震器：数据资产能否影响供应链韧性？
title_primary: 数字减震器：数据资产能否影响供应链韧性？
title_secondary: The digital shock absorber: can data assets influence supply chain resilience?
authors: Hongze Zhang, Weigang Ma
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In the context of the burgeoning digital economy, data assets have emerged as a vital determinant of strategic advantage, offering substantial potential to fortify supply chain resilience (SCR). Utilizing a dataset comprising Chinese listed companies spanning the period from 2007 through 2024, this study empirically investigates the relationship between data assets and SCR. The findings provide robust evidence that the data assets exert a statistically significant positive influence on SCR. Mechanism analysis indicates that this ameliorative effect is principally channelled through three distinct pathways: information transparency, corporate reputation, and production efficiency. Furthermore, market power has amplified the beneficial impact of data assets on SCR. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the observed positive effects are notably more potent within non-SOEs, firms with high digitalization levels, and firms facing low financing constraints. Analysis of spillover effects reveals that focal firms’ data assets significantly improve SCR among upstream suppliers but have no significant impact on downstream customers.
abstract_zh: 在数字经济蓬勃发展的背景下，数据资产已成为决定战略优势的关键因素，为增强供应链韧性（SCR）提供了巨大潜力。本研究利用2007年至2024年间中国上市公司的数据集，实证考察了数据资产与供应链韧性之间的关系。研究结果提供了有力证据，表明数据资产对供应链韧性具有统计上显著的正向影响。机制分析显示，这一改善效应主要通过三条不同路径实现：信息透明度、企业声誉和生产效率。此外，市场力量放大了数据资产对供应链韧性的有益影响。异质性分析揭示，上述正向效应在非国有企业、数字化水平较高的企业以及融资约束较低的企业中尤为显著。溢出效应分析表明，焦点企业的数据资产显著提升了上游供应商的供应链韧性，但对下游客户未产生显著影响。

title: Semi-nonparametric models of multidimensional matching: An optimal transport approach
title_zh: 多维匹配的半非参数模型：一种最优传输方法
title_primary: 多维匹配的半非参数模型：一种最优传输方法
title_secondary: Semi-nonparametric models of multidimensional matching: An optimal transport approach
authors: Dongwoo Kim, Young Jun Lee
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a set of empirically tractable and flexible sieve estimators for semi-nonparametric multidimensional matching models with transferable utility, focusing on worker-job matching. We generalize the parametric quadratic-Gaussian framework employed by Bojilov and Galichon (2016) and Lindenlaub (2017), which relies on joint normality of observed characteristics. We allow unrestricted distributions of characteristics and show identification of the production technology and the equilibrium wage and matching functions using optimal transport theory. Given identification, we propose efficient, consistent, and asymptotically normal sieve estimators. We revisit Lindenlaub’s empirical application and show that, between 1990 and 2010, the U.S. economy experienced much larger technological progress favoring cognitive abilities than the original findings suggest. Furthermore, our flexible model specifications provide a significantly better fit for patterns in the evolution of wage inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一套经验上易于处理且灵活的筛子估计量，用于具有可转移效用的半非参数多维匹配模型，重点关注工人-职位匹配。我们推广了Bojilov和Galichon（2016）及Lindenlaub（2017）所采用的参数二次高斯框架，该框架依赖于观测特征的联合正态性。我们允许特征分布不受限制，并利用最优传输理论证明了生产技术以及均衡工资和匹配函数的可识别性。在识别的基础上，我们提出了高效、一致且渐近正态的筛子估计量。我们重新审视了Lindenlaub的实证应用，并表明在1990年至2010年间，美国经济经历了比原始发现所暗示的更为显著的技术进步，偏向于认知能力。此外，我们灵活的模型设定为工资不平等演变模式提供了显著更好的拟合。

title: FDI and coal lock-in: The Global South’s development dilemma
title_zh: 外商直接投资与煤炭锁定：全球南方的发展困境
title_primary: 外商直接投资与煤炭锁定：全球南方的发展困境
title_secondary: FDI and coal lock-in: The Global South’s development dilemma
authors: Xinya Hao, Lin Zhang, Huanhuan Zheng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Why do poorer countries continue to adopt coal-fired power despite global climate pressures, while richer countries phase it out? This paper argues that the divergence in coal power phase-out trajectories between the Global North and South is driven by the coupling of greenfield investment with coal-fired power expansion in the Global South. Using matched global greenfield investments at the project level with coal plants at the city-level and employing the stacked DID strategy, we find that new coal-fired power installations increase cities’ inbound greenfield investment by 7.9% annually over eight years, particularly in low- and lower-middle-income countries; however, the inward capital is less oriented toward renewable technologies. This linkage arises from structural asymmetries: capital flows from the Global North to the South, the relocation of energy-intensive industries, and fragmented environmental regulation. Our findings highlight that the dilemma faced by developing countries: phasing out coal-fired power entails extremely high opportunity costs, while expanding coal power capacity crowds out investments in renewable technologies. Overall, we provide new evidence on how uneven development constraints result in fossil fuel dependency in the Global South.
abstract_zh: 为什么较贫穷的国家在全球气候压力下仍继续采用燃煤发电，而较富裕的国家却在逐步淘汰？本文认为，全球北方与南方之间煤电淘汰轨迹的分化，是由绿地投资与全球南方燃煤发电扩张的耦合所驱动。利用项目层面的全球绿地投资与城市层面的燃煤电厂相匹配的数据，并采用堆叠双重差分策略，我们发现新建燃煤电厂使城市年度外来绿地投资在八年内增加7.9%，尤其是在低收入和中等偏下收入国家；然而，这些流入资本对可再生技术的导向性较弱。这种关联源于结构性不对称：资本从全球北方流向南方、能源密集型产业的转移以及碎片化的环境监管。我们的研究结果凸显了发展中国家面临的困境：淘汰燃煤发电意味着极高的机会成本，而扩大煤电产能则会挤出对可再生技术的投资。总体而言，我们为不均衡发展约束如何导致全球南方对化石燃料的依赖提供了新的证据。

title: Informal institutions and global trade: Real effects of the elusive
title_zh: 非正式制度与全球贸易：难以捉摸的真实效应
title_primary: 非正式制度与全球贸易：难以捉摸的真实效应
title_secondary: Informal institutions and global trade: Real effects of the elusive
authors: Eiji Fujii
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Countries increasingly participate in informal intergovernmental forums such as the G7, G20, BRICS, and MIKTA. Unlike formal bodies such as the EU and WTO, these informal institutions lack permanent administrative structures and operate without legally binding commitments. Despite their growing prominence, their role in shaping global trade remains insufficiently examined. This study investigates whether these forums reflect structural shifts in the global economy that materially affect trade flows. Using a gravity framework and a dataset covering more than 200 countries (1994–2023), we identify the trade–facilitating effects of informal institutions. Our results show that participation in BRICS, in particular, generates trade gains comparable to those associated with formal regional trade agreements or WTO accession. The findings reveal a novel channel of international economic integration that operates beyond legal commitments.
abstract_zh: 各国日益参与七国集团、二十国集团、金砖国家及MIKTA等非正式政府间论坛。与欧盟和世界贸易组织等正式机构不同，这些非正式制度缺乏常设行政架构，且在不具法律约束力的承诺下运作。尽管其重要性日益凸显，但它们在塑造全球贸易方面的作用仍未得到充分研究。本研究探讨这些论坛是否反映了全球经济中实质性影响贸易流动的结构性转变。利用引力模型框架及涵盖200多个国家（1994-2023年）的数据集，我们识别出非正式制度的贸易促进效应。结果显示，尤其是参与金砖国家，所产生的贸易收益可与正式区域贸易协定或加入世界贸易组织相媲美。研究揭示了一种超越法律承诺的国际经济一体化新渠道。

title: Tipping into protectionism: Tariff shocks and the fragility of free trade
title_zh: 转向保护主义：关税冲击与自由贸易的脆弱性

abstract: This paper develops a dynamic political-economy model of trade-policy hysteresis. Tariffs reduce innovation and competitiveness but generate short-run benefits for import-competing sectors, creating incentives for myopic policymakers to adopt protectionism. The interaction between myopic protectionist policy and slow-moving competitiveness generates two stable steady states: a low-tariff, high-competitiveness regime and a high-tariff, low-competitiveness regime. Although free trade is welfare superior, it is politically fragile. Temporary tariff shocks that sufficiently erode competitiveness can permanently shift political incentives toward protectionism, trapping the economy in a low-competitiveness equilibrium with persistently high tariffs and lower welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于贸易政策滞后性的动态政治经济学模型。关税降低了创新与竞争力，却为进口竞争部门带来短期利益，从而激励短视的政策制定者采取保护主义。短视的保护主义政策与缓慢变动的竞争力之间的相互作用，产生了两个稳定的稳态：一个低关税、高竞争力的体制，以及一个高关税、低竞争力的体制。尽管自由贸易在福利上更优，但在政治上却显得脆弱。暂时性的关税冲击若足以侵蚀竞争力，便能永久性地将政治激励转向保护主义，使经济陷入低竞争力均衡，伴随持续高关税与更低福利。

abstract: We extend the standard model of Hotelling competition to allow consumers, at personal cost, to change the default horizontal characteristic of the product they purchase. The potential to change this characteristic can cause the market equilibrium to switch from one in which each seller serves only its closest consumers to one in which one seller serves all consumers. This potential can also lead to the non-existence of equilibria. Although default-switching costs can reduce a seller's profit by reducing its product's appeal, they can also commit the seller to compete less vigorously for “distant” consumers, and thereby increase equilibrium profit.
abstract_zh: 我们扩展了霍特林竞争的标准模型，允许消费者以个人成本改变所购产品的默认水平特性。改变这一特性的可能性可能导致市场均衡从每个卖家仅服务其最近消费者的状态，转变为单一卖家服务所有消费者的状态。这种可能性也可能导致均衡不存在。尽管默认切换成本可能通过降低产品吸引力来减少卖家的利润，但它们也能使卖家承诺对“远距离”消费者竞争不那么激烈，从而增加均衡利润。

abstract: This paper empirically examines the use of different survey expectations in the U.S. Phillips curve. I find that between the Michigan Surveys of Consumers’ (MSC) and Survey of Professional Forecasters’ (SPF) short‐ and long‐term forecasts, short‐term forecasts from the MSC are the best measure of inflation expectations for use in the Phillips curve. These results are robust to specifications of the Phillips curve with different measures of inflation, labor market slack, and sample periods. Furthermore, I find that conditional forecasts of inflation using short‐term MSC expectations lead to the greatest improvement in out‐of‐sample Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) relative to other expectations.
abstract_zh: 本文实证检验了美国菲利普斯曲线中不同调查预期的使用情况。我发现，在密歇根消费者调查（MSC）与专业预测者调查（SPF）的短期和长期预测中，MSC的短期预测是菲利普斯曲线中衡量通胀预期的最佳指标。这些结果对于采用不同通胀衡量指标、劳动力市场松弛度及样本期的菲利普斯曲线设定均保持稳健。此外，我发现，使用MSC短期预期的通胀条件预测，相对于其他预期，在样本外均方根误差（RMSE）方面带来了最大改善。

abstract: This study examines a causal relationship between fiscal pressure and the market structure of government‐controlled factors of production, by exploiting a city‐level panel data set on urban land transactions in China. We find that in the face of higher fiscal pressure, local governments tend to transfer fewer land parcels and make the urban land market more concentrated. This kind of concentration, in turn, will lead to higher housing prices. This study has implications for other countries where the government controls certain types of production factors, such as land or natural resources.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用中国城市土地交易的面板数据，探讨了财政压力与政府控制生产要素市场结构之间的因果关系。研究发现，面对较高的财政压力，地方政府倾向于减少土地出让地块数量，导致城市土地市场更加集中。这种集中化进而推高了住房价格。本研究对于政府控制土地或自然资源等生产要素的其他国家具有借鉴意义。

abstract: Abstract Entry into many occupations is regulated to screen out the least able candidates, but available evidence suggests that this objective is rarely achieved. Using microdata covering the universe of Italian law school graduates (2007-2013), we show that this result is largely due to the strong intergenerational transmission of occupations within regulated professions. We find that having relatives already active as lawyers significantly increases the probability of passing the entry exam and boosts earnings, particularly for those who performed poorly in law school.
abstract_zh: 许多职业的准入受到监管，旨在筛选出能力最弱的候选人，但现有证据表明这一目标很少实现。利用覆盖意大利法学院毕业生总体（2007-2013年）的微观数据，我们表明这一结果在很大程度上归因于受监管职业内部强烈的代际职业传承。我们发现，已有亲属从事律师职业显著提高了通过入职考试的概率，并提升了收入，尤其是对法学院表现不佳者而言。

title: Product churn, tastes, and price indices

authors: Hao Lan, Tim Lloyd, Steve McCorriston, Cesar Revoredo‐Giha
official: 官方在线 2025-11-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Price indices commonly used to measure inflation do not account for the entry and exit of products nor for systemic changes in consumer preferences over time. Recent developments in the theory of price indices show that these issues have significant impacts on the growth of prices that consumers experience. However, executing these developments requires access to household-level data. Analyzing the ready meal purchases of 30,000 UK households during 2013–2022, we evaluate the extent of the bias between standard price indices and those that accommodate product churn as well as changes in consumer tastes. Household data also permit the effects to be calculated across income groups. Our results show that price indices commonly used to measure inflation significantly overstate the extent of price increases due to: (i) “representative” prices used to measure the Consumer Prices Index do not adequately capture the prices of goods in household baskets, and (ii) the effect of the net entry of products and taste changes, the latter being particularly strong. Furthermore, differences in the shopping baskets across income groups suggest that inflation varies across the income distribution. We find that when product churn and taste changes are accounted for, ready meals prices rose over the period by around 3% in low-income households compared with a rise of 12% and 14% in middle- and higher-income households, respectively. These issues are important not only for measuring cost-of-living and how it varies across income groups but also in addressing policy issues more generally.
abstract_zh: 常用于衡量通胀的价格指数并未考虑产品的进入与退出，也未考虑消费者偏好随时间的系统性变化。近期价格指数理论的发展表明，这些问题对消费者所经历的价格增长具有显著影响。然而，实施这些发展需要获取家庭层面的数据。通过分析2013年至2022年间30,000个英国家庭的即食餐购买情况，我们评估了标准价格指数与那些考虑产品更替及消费者口味变化的价格指数之间的偏差程度。家庭数据还允许我们计算不同收入群体间的效应。我们的结果显示，常用于衡量通胀的价格指数显著高估了价格上涨的程度，原因在于：（i）用于衡量消费者价格指数的“代表性”价格未能充分捕捉家庭购物篮中商品的价格，以及（ii）产品净进入和口味变化的影响，后者尤为显著。此外，不同收入群体间购物篮的差异表明，通胀在收入分配中有所差异。我们发现，在考虑产品更替和口味变化后，即食餐价格在研究期间内低收入家庭上涨约3%，而中高收入家庭分别上涨12%和14%。这些问题不仅对于衡量生活成本及其在不同收入群体间的差异至关重要，而且在更广泛的政策问题处理中也具有重要意义。
